skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles, nature, and foundations of social insurance management.
Comprehend the basic contents of social insurance management including organizational structure, participant management, beneficiary management, and financial management.
Understand the organizational structure of social insurance in various countries and Vietnam.
Manage participants in social insurance, including mandatory and voluntary participants.
Manage the financial aspects of social insurance, including principles, content, and forecasting.
Apply knowledge of social insurance management to formulate policies and development strategies for social insurance agencies.
Develop independent research skills, including synthesis, analysis, and systematic thinking.
Manage resources effectively for specialized social insurance management activities.
Plan, coordinate, manage resources, assess, and improve the effectiveness of activities.
Lead teams, evaluate performance, supervise, and inspire team members in executing assigned tasks and social activities.
